numerical_failure.affected_api: pandas.io.parsers.readers.read_csv with engine="c" (TextReader in pandas/_libs/parsers.pyx; overflow fallback in the integer column conversion; new helper _try_pylong)
numerical_failure.observed_behavior: Before the fix, when integer parsing overflowed (integers larger than 64 bits), the C engine fell back to reading the column as object/string via _convert_with_dtype, so big integers were returned as strings rather than Python integers.
numerical_failure.expected_behavior: Integers larger than 64 bits should be read as Python integers (PyLongObject) with engine="c"; if a value cannot be parsed as a Python integer (_try_pylong raises ValueError), the code falls back to the previous string-based object conversion. A column with an overflowing integer followed by a string value should remain a string column with the string form of the value.
trigger_conditions: a column contains integer values exceeding 64 bits so that int64 parsing raises OverflowError
an overflowing integer followed by a non-integer string in the same column keeps the column as strings (uint64_range_follow_str test)
